flow.name: track-shipment-tool-flow
flow.doc:name: Tool: track_shipment
flow.doc:description: MCP tool flow that returns detailed shipment tracking for a given trackingNumber or orderId

mcp:tool-listener.name: track_shipment
mcp:tool-listener.doc:name: MCP Tool Listener: track_shipment
mcp:tool-listener.doc:description: Registers track_shipment tool; fires on tools/call for this tool name
mcp:tool-listener.mcp:description: Track a shipment and retrieve carrier details, current status, tracking milestones, and estimated delivery date. Supply either trackingNumber or orderId — at least one is required.

mcp:text-tool-response-content.text: #[write(vars.mcpError default {code: 'INTERNAL_ERROR', message: 'An unexpected error occurred during shipment tracking.'}, 'application/json')]

set-variable.doc:name: Extract trackingNumber
set-variable.doc:description: Extracts optional trackingNumber from tool call input

set-variable.doc:name: Extract orderId
set-variable.doc:description: Extracts optional orderId from tool call input

choice.doc:name: Validate Input
choice.doc:description: Ensures at least trackingNumber or orderId is supplied

set-variable.value: #[{code: 'INVALID_INPUT', message: 'Provide either trackingNumber or orderId to track a shipment.'}]
set-variable.doc:name: Set Missing Input Error
set-variable.doc:description: Builds INVALID_INPUT error when neither trackingNumber nor orderId is supplied

raise-error.doc:name: Raise INVALID_INPUT
raise-error.doc:description: Propagates error so mcp:on-error-responses returns the structured error

ee:transform.doc:name: Find Shipment and Build Milestones
ee:transform.doc:description: Reads mock-orders.json, matches by trackingNumber or orderId, returns tracking detail with mock milestones

ee:message.ee:set-payload:
%dw 2.0 output application/java var allOrders = readUrl("classpath://mock-orders.json", "application/json") var byTracking = if (vars.trackingNumber != '') allOrders filter ($.trackingNumber == vars.trackingNumber) else allOrders var byOrder = if (vars.orderId != '') byTracking filter ($.orderId == vars.orderId) else byTracking var order = if (sizeOf(byOrder) > 0) byOrder[0] else null
// Build mock milestone events based on shippingStatus var milestones = if (order == null) [] else if (order.shippingStatus == "NOT_SHIPPED") [ {event: "Order Placed", location: "Warehouse", timestamp: (order.orderDate as String) ++ "T08:00:00Z"} ] else if (order.shippingStatus == "SHIPPED") [ {event: "Order Placed", location: "Warehouse", timestamp: (order.orderDate as String) ++ "T08:00:00Z"}, {event: "Picked Up by Carrier", location: "Dispatch Center", timestamp: (order.orderDate as String) ++ "T18:00:00Z"}, {event: "In Transit", location: "Regional Sorting Hub", timestamp: (order.lastUpdated as String)} ] else if (order.shippingStatus == "DELIVERED") [ {event: "Order Placed", location: "Warehouse", timestamp: (order.orderDate as String) ++ "T08:00:00Z"}, {event: "Picked Up by Carrier", location: "Dispatch Center", timestamp: (order.orderDate as String) ++ "T18:00:00Z"}, {event: "In Transit", location: "Regional Sorting Hub", timestamp: (order.orderDate as String) ++ "T22:00:00Z"}, {event: "Out for Delivery", location: "Local Delivery Hub", timestamp: (order.estimatedDeliveryDate as String) ++ "T07:00:00Z"}, {event: "Delivered", location: "Customer Address", timestamp: (order.lastUpdated as String)} ] else [] --- if (order != null) { orderId: order.orderId, trackingNumber: order.trackingNumber, carrier: order.carrier, shippingStatus: order.shippingStatus, estimatedDeliveryDate: order.estimatedDeliveryDate, milestones: milestones } else null

choice.doc:name: Shipment Found?
choice.doc:description: Routes to success or raises SHIPMENT_NOT_FOUND

set-variable.value: #[{code: 'SHIPMENT_NOT_FOUND', message: 'No shipment was found for the supplied tracking number or order ID.', trackingNumber: (vars.trackingNumber default ''), orderId: (vars.orderId default '')}]
set-variable.doc:name: Set Not Found Error

logger.message: #['[' ++ correlationId ++ '] track_shipment | orderId=' ++ (payload.orderId default '') ++ ' | shippingStatus=' ++ (payload.shippingStatus default '')]
logger.doc:name: Log Success

on-error-propagate.doc:name: Handle INVALID_INPUT
on-error-propagate.doc:description: Propagates INVALID_INPUT so mcp:on-error-responses sends the structured error

logger.message: #['[' ++ correlationId ++ '] track_shipment | INVALID_INPUT - no trackingNumber or orderId supplied']
logger.doc:name: Log Invalid Input

on-error-propagate.doc:name: Handle SHIPMENT_NOT_FOUND
on-error-propagate.doc:description: Propagates SHIPMENT_NOT_FOUND so mcp:on-error-responses sends the structured error

logger.message: #['[' ++ correlationId ++ '] track_shipment | SHIPMENT_NOT_FOUND | trackingNumber=' ++ (vars.trackingNumber default '') ++ ' | orderId=' ++ (vars.orderId default '')]
logger.doc:name: Log Not Found

flow.name: check-inventory-tool-flow
flow.doc:name: Tool: check_inventory
flow.doc:description: MCP tool flow that returns inventory stock details for a product SKU

mcp:tool-listener.name: check_inventory
mcp:tool-listener.doc:name: MCP Tool Listener: check_inventory
mcp:tool-listener.doc:description: Registers check_inventory tool; fires on tools/call for this tool name
mcp:tool-listener.mcp:description: Check the current inventory stock level for a product SKU. Returns available quantity, warehouse location, reorder level, and stock status (IN_STOCK, LOW_STOCK, OUT_OF_STOCK).

mcp:text-tool-response-content.text: #[write(vars.mcpError default {code: 'INTERNAL_ERROR', message: 'An unexpected error occurred while checking inventory.'}, 'application/json')]

set-variable.doc:name: Extract sku
set-variable.doc:description: Extracts and trims SKU from tool call input

choice.doc:name: Validate sku
choice.doc:description: Rejects missing or empty SKU before querying mock data

set-variable.value: #[{code: 'INVALID_INPUT', message: 'sku is required to check inventory.', sku: vars.sku}]
set-variable.doc:name: Set Empty SKU Error
set-variable.doc:description: Builds INVALID_INPUT error when SKU is missing or empty

raise-error.doc:name: Raise INVALID_INPUT
raise-error.doc:description: Propagates error so mcp:on-error-responses returns the structured error

ee:transform.doc:name: Find Inventory Item
ee:transform.doc:description: Reads mock-inventory.json and returns the matching product record or null

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/java var allItems = readUrl("classpath://mock-inventory.json", "application/json") var matches = allItems filter ($.sku == vars.sku) --- if (sizeOf(matches) > 0) matches[0] else null

choice.doc:name: Product Found?
choice.doc:description: Routes to success or raises PRODUCT_NOT_FOUND

set-variable.value: #[{code: 'PRODUCT_NOT_FOUND', message: 'No product was found for the supplied SKU.', sku: vars.sku}]
set-variable.doc:name: Set Not Found Error

logger.message: #['[' ++ correlationId ++ '] check_inventory | sku=' ++ vars.sku ++ ' | status=' ++ (payload.status default 'unknown') ++ ' | available=' ++ (payload.availableQuantity as String)]
logger.doc:name: Log Success
logger.doc:description: Logs successful inventory lookup with SKU, status, and available quantity

on-error-propagate.doc:name: Handle INVALID_INPUT
on-error-propagate.doc:description: Propagates INVALID_INPUT so mcp:on-error-responses sends the structured error

logger.message: #['[' ++ correlationId ++ '] check_inventory | INVALID_INPUT - sku is empty']
logger.doc:name: Log Invalid Input

on-error-propagate.doc:name: Handle PRODUCT_NOT_FOUND
on-error-propagate.doc:description: Propagates PRODUCT_NOT_FOUND so mcp:on-error-responses sends the structured error
